title: CURRICULUM DESIGN AND INSTRUCTIONAL METHODS
description: Explore innovative approaches to secondary instruction through the lens of research-based strategies. Engage in the development of effective instructional practices that enhance student learning and promote critical thinking in alignment with the current state and national standards. Incorporate technology, use formative assessments, and apply culturally responsive teaching methods to effectively support diverse learners. Collaborate to build a professional network, recognize the importance of cultural competence in education, and refine communication skills to foster meaningful interactions with students, parents, and peers
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Secondary Education (A041).
